## Software

All R results in this edition were computed with the versions below. The build stores the results in `_freeze/`,
so the published version can be reproduced without re-running every chapter; a fresh run with newer package
versions may differ in the last digits of some estimates.

```{r}
#| label: software-versions
#| echo: false
pakete <- c("ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "lme4", "nlme", "deSolve", "glmnet", "pROC", "dagitty",
            "class", "cluster", "mclust", "simmer", "forecast", "digest", "knitr", "rmarkdown")
installiert <- pakete[vapply(pakete, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
versionen <- data.frame(
  Component = c("R", installiert),
  Version = c(paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
              vapply(installiert, function(p) as.character(utils::packageVersion(p)), character(1)))
)
knitr::kable(versionen, row.names = FALSE)
```

Quarto renders the book; the version used for the published build is set in the repository's GitHub Actions
workflow.

## Legal status

The chapters on regulation, data protection and security (@sec-b22 to @sec-b26) give the reference date and source
for each legal statement. Statements about dates of application refer to the version of the legal text in force in
November 2026. Local responsibilities and national implementation must be checked for each institution.

## Use of AI tools

Used for support, including Chat AI (KISSKI/GWDG) and locally hosted models, some self-trained or weight-edited
(Linux, Intel/NVIDIA; no data shared with third parties). All content and references were revised and verified by
the author.
